title: Constitutional Active Reality Consolidation — Phase 1 Classification

steps.name: Non-destructive authority-chain classification and candidate extraction
steps.acceptance: Report lists every authority-bearing artifact from the first-pass scan with exact claim, claimed scope, granting source, active consumers, runtime reachability, conflict, disposition, and action owner. A Constitutional Candidate Ledger captures valuable unrepresented principles. No active files are moved/renamed/deleted. A Scope Deviation Note records that the originally announced Idea Lifecycle Registry / institutional-maturity dashboard were not built in this slice.

steps.name: Founder review and disposition lock
steps.acceptance: Adam/Chair reviews the report and the candidate ledger; for each unique file the lock records current path, current claim, legitimate scope, higher authority, unique value, active consumers, final disposition, active replacement, decision authority, move authorization, required verification, and rollback method.

steps.name: Controlled relocation, relabeling, or rewriting of approved dispositions
steps.acceptance: Each approved disposition is executed with a supersession receipt (old path, new historical path, prior authority claim, active replacement, reason, unique content preserved, affected imports, parity checks, rollback path). Active references are updated and proven not to read from history.

steps.name: Proof that active systems cannot consume the historical archive
steps.acceptance: A verifier demonstrates that no runtime codepath, agent read order, gate, or active registry reads from `docs/history/` or retired paths unless explicitly routed through Wisdom / Digital Twin historical-retrieval endpoints.

steps.name: Implementation Engine lifecycle registry and institutional-maturity dashboard
steps.acceptance: A reusable script composes existing signals (BUILD_QUEUE.json, ENFORCEMENT_MATRIX, PRODUCT_REGISTRY, BP_PRIORITY, FILE_MANIFEST, verified dispositions) into a per-idea lifecycle state from DISCOVERED → MATURE and emits a maturity dashboard. Explicitly deferred until CARC-001–CARC-004 are complete.
